menu-title.purpose: Pause, guide and settings headings, Bold.

region-speaker.purpose: Map region and dialogue speaker, Bold.

level-title.purpose: Lesson header, Bold; journey uses the shorter task role.

journey-task.purpose: Journey gameplay destination and map task, Bold.

body.purpose: Feedback, instruction, help and result copy, Regular.

focus.purpose: Selected symbol in optional precision controls, Regular.

secondary.purpose: Map restored count, Regular; Skip story uses Bold at this size.

receiver-label.purpose: Complete destination label, Bold; compensated by canvas scale.

device.purpose: Explanation text, Regular, compensated by canvas scale; device glyphs use Bold.

token-glyph.purpose: Live Bold face that lifts and scales with the held token.

target-glyph.purpose: Live Bold face in the complete receiver order.

shadows.name: soft-contact
shadows.purpose: Native contact shader on fitted quads beneath tokens, platforms and receiver; references colors.contact-shadow. Cast Unity shadows are disabled.

motion.name: hold-preview
motion.purpose: Native body and live glyph scale/lift together while fixed cells retain hit testing. X displacement is bounded to 1.15 cell spacings; upward pointer delta to 0.45 cell spacings.

motion.name: selection
motion.purpose: Focus selection, distinct from immediate held feedback. Reduced Motion applies focus directly.

motion.name: exchange
motion.purpose: Short opposing arcs describe the committed atomic adjacent or linked exchange.

motion.name: device-response
motion.purpose: Local rail recoil capped at 0.025 world units. Screen shake is opt-in, off by default, and suppressed by Reduced Motion.

motion.name: fall-and-land
motion.purpose: Whole-row travel down guides with at most 8% landing squash. Complete target remains visible.

motion.name: delivery
motion.purpose: Result UI follows final visual synchronization. Dust/audio tails do not determine gameplay or command completion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No causal travel, recoil or deformation; at most two stationary dust fades per burst. Ambient layers show phase zero.

motion.name: ambient-wheel
motion.purpose: Lower-right native windwheel. Reduced Motion fixes 18deg; pause/suspension stop phase progression.

motion.name: ambient-clouds
motion.value: normalized phase rates 0.017 / 0.026 / 0.035 per second; wrap span 1.7
motion.purpose: Three separate transparent cloud planes at different depths and widths; original art tinted by region.

motion.name: ambient-plants
motion.purpose: Mirrored lower-corner cutouts pivot about their stems; side offset is 0 or 1.

motion.name: ambient-glider
motion.value: angle = phase * 0.07; x = sin(angle) * viewportWidth * 0.34; rotation = -6deg + sin(angle) * 9deg
motion.purpose: Whole rotated 3:2 image fits the bounded gap between feedback and top floor. Height is at most min(viewportHeight * 0.05, gap * 0.5), vertical drift is gap * 0.08. Hidden during held input or unavailable gap; menu pose is separate.

motion.name: ambient-lifecycle
motion.value: unscaled presentation phase; stop while paused or suspended
motion.purpose: Presentation-only. Map and dialogue pause interaction and therefore retain a static ambient phase. Reduced Motion paints phase zero.

breakpoints.name: precision-input
breakpoints.value: explicit Comfort preference; no width or row-count breakpoint

components.name: Descend / Deliver and travel
components.description: Native Unity Button with gold nine-slice Image, Bold TMP and ColorBlock tints. Gameplay height is compensated; menu/dialogue heights follow their native layout. Descend becomes Deliver only at a matching final-floor row. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

components.name: Utility and menu action
components.description: Native warm paper Button. Gameplay actions are compensated 48-unit bands; the button-menu variant uses 60 reference units. Custom keyboard focus treatment is not established. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

components.name: Optional precision control
components.description: Native authored chevron focus controls and left/right exchange actions. Enabled explicitly in Comfort; never forced by row length. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

components.name: Held persistent piece
components.description: Native beveled symbol mesh plus live TMP glyph. Immediate lift, 1.10–2.5 scale toward a 64-pixel face, fixed input cells and adjacent legality preview. Body and glyph move together; release routes through the existing resolver. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

components.name: Regional platform
components.description: Native compact beam with brass caps and graphite damage seams. Wind Gardens uses Platform Mint, Rain Mill Star Sky, Copper Orchard Device Coral. Shared device faces retain stable SymbolId identity. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

components.name: Complete receiving cradle
components.description: Native gold rim, ivory inset, sockets and the complete ordered target. Inspectable through target zoom; fail compares target and delivered row, win seats the row before result actions. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

components.name: Journey route and stop
components.description: Native uGUI over original isometric regional raster art. Five numbered stops per page, progress pebbles and Mika at the actual next session stop. Current/restored variants follow the frontmatter; future pages explain distance and return to the current path. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

components.name: Story frame
components.description: Native paper nine-slice panel, thin brass detail, live speaker and short dialogue with Continue/Skip story. Original alpha portrait and regional background. Opening dialogue pauses puzzle input. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

components.name: Comfort and sound setting
components.description: Native labelled paper row with track color and positional knob. Preferences are in memory; no save claim. Larger text excludes symbol faces and explicit font/layout overrides remain. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

components.name: Exact-order magnifier
components.description: Native safe-area paper surface with four columns and up to two rows, original shape contours/live glyphs and position labels. Pauses gameplay; no browser counterpart. Documentation is native-only; HTML/CSS preview intentionally absent.

narrative.overview:
A small keeper carries light through floating islands and wind-powered toy machines. Mint enamel, warm brass, ivory letter tiles and six colored silhouettes make the puzzle tangible. Mika's patched overalls, saffron scarf and lantern connect the mechanism to a warm, imperfect character. Painted regional skies and isometric routes give each delivery a place and a neighbour.

Real beveled meshes, an orthographic view, live lettering and separate illustrated scenery share the same bright storybook world. The hand touches the row directly; quiet controls leave room for the machine and its complete gold destination. Paper panels support short dialogue and navigation. This is the author-delegated, code-led extension of the established world; no approved composite image exists for pixel-perfect fidelity claims.

This record merges the implemented P14 journey revision into the P12/P13 system. Sources are `CascadeGame.cs`, `.Flow.cs`, `.Journey.cs`, `.Touch.cs`, `TokenSlot.cs`, `ToyMachineView.cs`, `LayeredWorld.cs`, `JourneyStory.cs`, `ToyAssetBuilder.cs` and `MotionProfile.asset`. `Docs/JOURNEY_SURFACE_BRIEF.md` owns the surface contract; `Docs/P14_FLOW.md` owns implementation scope and validation limits. Native captures and review live in `Reports/Journey`. `Docs/JOURNEY_ASSET_PROVENANCE.md` records the 12 original regional/character rasters; earlier mesh, font and audio provenance remains in the P12/P13 documents. The sidecar records native components and motion, with no fabricated HTML/CSS counterparts. Its synthesized tonal ramps are preview aids, not shipped palette additions.
keyCharacteristics: Direct touch lifts a piece and its live glyph together; the receiver stays visible.
Six stable silhouettes and colors remain readable across all three regions.
Enamel rails, brass joints and soft contact shadows make the machine tangible.
Mika, Pip and Rue connect short optional dialogue to a concrete destination.
Illustrated routes distinguish the current path from future-region browsing.
Clouds, rooted plants, a glider and the lower-right windwheel give the sky restrained life.

rules.name: The Shared Identity Rule
rules.body: Use the same silhouette and material for a SymbolId in the row, target, device contact and magnifier; glyph symbols use live text on ivory bodies.

rules.name: The Live Face Rule
rules.body: Move and scale a letter with its mesh face through selection, holding, exchange and landing; never bake gameplay letters into scenery.

rules.name: The Complete Machine Rule
rules.body: Keep the persistent row, remaining floors and complete receiver order visible together; changing row length must preserve clear physical rail proportions.

rules.name: The Honest Path Rule
rules.body: Distinguish the browsed stop from the reached stop; future art must never imply unlocked or saved progress.

rules.name: The Clear Flight Rule
rules.body: Decorative motion must fit wholly outside the row, receiver and feedback; a lower render layer alone is not sufficient separation.

dos: **Do** reuse each authored silhouette and material wherever its SymbolId appears.
**Do** move and scale the live glyph with its selected or held body.
**Do** preserve the complete target and the direct-touch default.
**Do** keep precision controls an explicit Comfort preference.
**Do** bind the map marker to actual session progress and label future previews honestly.
**Do** select the story's region before showing its character and dialogue.
**Do** bound ambient art outside gameplay information and freeze its phase while paused or suspended.
**Do** inspect native 390 × 844, 320 × 693 and wide Editor captures after layout changes.
**Do** preserve original assets, licenses, generation provenance and Unity meta identities.
donts: **Don't** turn physical rails into full-width rectangular cards or restore the crowded default toolbar.
**Don't** bake gameplay text into imagery or change symbol identity to indicate state.
**Don't** let presentation, animation completion, scenery, physics or ad callbacks change puzzle state.
**Don't** portray browsed islands as reached or session memory as durable saving.
**Don't** describe the 160-stop target, ranks, parcels, keepsakes, Long Reach or online concept as implemented.
**Don't** copy ShapeMania screens, characters, sprites, props or materials into this world.
**Don't** equate Editor captures and automated tests with device, haptic, performance, build, native-language or human-enjoyment proof.
